title: Scalable URL Shortener Service
source: Build a scalable URL shortener service with APIs, persistence, and analytics.
summary: A .NET 8 URL shortener that converts long URLs into short codes, redirects visitors with low latency, persists mappings and click events, and exposes owner-facing analytics through versioned REST APIs. The workload is read-heavy (redirects far outnumber creates).

stack.persistence: EF Core + SQL Server (Azure SQL in production)

requirements.title: Create short URL
requirements.statement: Clients can create a short URL for a valid long URL.

acceptance_criteria.then: 201 Created is returned with shortCode, shortUrl, originalUrl, createdAt, expiresAt

acceptance_criteria.given: an invalid or malformed URL, or a scheme other than http/https
acceptance_criteria.then: 400 is returned with a ProblemDetails body

acceptance_criteria.given: a URL without a custom alias
acceptance_criteria.then: the code is unique, 7 characters long and Base62 encoded

acceptance_criteria.given: a repeat request with the same Idempotency-Key
acceptance_criteria.then: the original result is returned and no duplicate is created

requirements.title: Custom alias
requirements.statement: Clients can request a custom alias as the short code.

acceptance_criteria.when: a URL is created with that alias
acceptance_criteria.then: the alias is used as the short code

acceptance_criteria.given: an alias that is already taken, or a reserved word (api, admin, health, swagger)
acceptance_criteria.when: a URL is created with that alias
acceptance_criteria.then: 409 Conflict is returned for a taken alias, 400 for a reserved word

requirements.title: Redirect
requirements.statement: Visitors are redirected from a short code to the original URL.

acceptance_criteria.then: 302 Found is returned with Location set to the original URL

acceptance_criteria.given: an unknown, expired or disabled code
acceptance_criteria.then: 404 is returned for an unknown code, 410 Gone for an expired or disabled one
a click event is recorded asynchronously without blocking the response

requirements.title: Expiry
requirements.statement: Short URLs can have an optional expiry time.

acceptance_criteria.given: an expiresAt value that is not a future UTC timestamp
acceptance_criteria.when: a URL is created or updated
acceptance_criteria.then: 400 is returned

acceptance_criteria.given: a URL whose expiresAt has passed
acceptance_criteria.then: 410 Gone is returned

requirements.title: Manage URLs
requirements.statement: Owners can view, list, update and delete their short URLs.

acceptance_criteria.given: an existing URL owned by the caller
acceptance_criteria.then: the URL metadata is returned
a paginated list of the caller's URLs is returned

acceptance_criteria.when: PATCH updates expiresAt/isActive, or DELETE is called
acceptance_criteria.then: the changes are saved; a deleted URL is soft-deleted and its redirect returns 410

acceptance_criteria.given: a URL owned by someone else
acceptance_criteria.when: the caller tries to read or modify it
acceptance_criteria.then: 403 Forbidden is returned

requirements.title: Analytics
requirements.statement: Owners can view click analytics for their short URLs.

acceptance_criteria.then: timestamp, code, referrer, device, browser, OS and country are stored, and the IP is hashed or anonymized, never stored raw
total clicks, unique clicks and a time series are returned
top-N breakdowns by referrer, country, device and browser are included
the click appears within 60 seconds (eventual consistency)

requirements.title: Authentication
requirements.statement: Management and analytics APIs are protected; redirects are public.

acceptance_criteria.given: a request without a valid X-Api-Key or JWT bearer token
acceptance_criteria.when: a management or analytics API is called
acceptance_criteria.then: 401 Unauthorized is returned
the redirect works without authentication

requirements.title: Rate limiting and abuse protection
requirements.statement: The service limits abuse of URL creation and of redirect targets.

acceptance_criteria.given: an API key that has exceeded the create rate limit (default 100 per minute)
acceptance_criteria.then: 429 Too Many Requests is returned with a Retry-After header

acceptance_criteria.given: a destination URL on the configurable domain blocklist
acceptance_criteria.then: 400 is returned

acceptance_criteria.given: a destination URL that points to the service's own domain
acceptance_criteria.then: 400 is returned, preventing redirect loops

requirements.title: Observability and health
requirements.statement: The service exposes health checks, structured logs and metrics.

acceptance_criteria.then: liveness is reported, and readiness reflects the database and cache status
structured Serilog logs are written with a correlation ID
OpenTelemetry metrics for request count, request latency and cache hit ratio are available

requirements.title: API documentation and versioning
requirements.statement: All APIs are documented and versioned.

acceptance_criteria.when: Swagger UI or openapi.yaml is opened
acceptance_criteria.then: every endpoint is documented with its request/response schemas and error codes
it is served under the /api/v1 prefix

nfrs.statement: Redirect p95 < 50 ms on a cache hit and < 150 ms on a miss; create p95 < 200 ms
Stateless, horizontally scalable API; designed for ~1,000 redirects/sec and ~100 creates/sec (read:write ~100:1)
99.9% target for redirects; redirects keep working if the analytics pipeline is down
nfrs.verification: integration test with the analytics worker stopped

nfrs.statement: No mapping is lost once 201 has been returned; click events are delivered at least once
Supports 100M+ URLs; raw clicks kept for 90 days, aggregates kept indefinitely
nfrs.verification: schema and index review; retention job test

nfrs.statement: OWASP Top 10 mitigated; HTTPS only; input validated; no secrets in code

nfrs.verification: unit test on click recording; schema review

nfrs.statement: Clean Architecture; >= 80% line coverage on Domain and Application; no analyzer warnings
nfrs.verification: coverlet report; dotnet build with analyzers

nfrs.statement: Dockerfile and docker-compose (API, Worker, SQL Server, Redis); config via appsettings and environment variables

constraints: EF Core with SQL Server; Redis read-through cache
Asynchronous click ingestion via a background queue and a Worker service
expected_outputs: ADRs: short-code generation, cache strategy, analytics pipeline
out_of_scope: Malware scanning beyond the domain blocklist

assumptions.question: Should redirects use 301 or 302?
assumptions.text: Use 302 so every click reaches the server and can be counted

assumptions.question: How are short codes generated?
assumptions.text: Random Base62 with a retry on collision; a counter- or Snowflake-based scheme is documented as an alternative

assumptions.question: Does the same long URL always get the same code?
assumptions.text: No; each request gets a new code unless the Idempotency-Key matches

assumptions.question: How is 'scalable' verified?
assumptions.text: Against the NFR-2 targets with a local load test; no cloud deployment

assumptions.question: Can anonymous users create links?
assumptions.text: No; creating a link requires an API key

assumptions.question: Where does country data come from?
assumptions.text: A pluggable IGeoLocator with a stub implementation; a MaxMind database is optional

assumptions.question: What counts as a 'unique click'?
assumptions.text: A distinct hash of IP + user agent per day

assumptions.question: Is a UI required?
assumptions.text: No; the service is API-only, with Swagger UI

risks.risk: Cache stampede or stale entries after a URL is deleted or expires
risks.mitigation: Cache TTL <= expiry; invalidate on update; single-flight loading

risks.risk: Very popular codes overloading the database
risks.mitigation: Redis cache plus in-memory LRU; read replicas

risks.risk: Click events lost if the queue or worker crashes
risks.mitigation: Durable queue (Service Bus) or outbox; at-least-once delivery with idempotent aggregation
Unique index plus retry; monitor the collision rate; option to extend code length
Domain blocklist, rate limits, ability to disable a code

risks.risk: Unbounded growth of the ClickEvents table
